sources_used: Google web results / Facebook / Instagram snippets for UK arcades

findings.name: Funland
findings.evidence_quote: Redemption all the way here.
findings.note: Skegness seafront; ZIv and pipeline notes list only coin pushers (Deal Or No Deal, Rainbow Riches, Willy Wonka, etc.). No rhythm cabs. Inventory age unverified beyond 2019.

findings.name: Funland Amusement Park
findings.evidence_quote: June '23- a surprisingly nice arcade for a funfair that looks quite dilapidated when you first drive past. No DDR anymore, but 5 good pinballs.
findings.note: Hayling Island. Older ZIv text mentioned ITG and EuroMIX2; comments say ITG cab gone years ago. June 2023 visit positively states no DDR. No current music-game list entries.

findings.name: Funspot Amusements
findings.evidence_quote: Small arcade with 2p coin pushers, a small selection of arcade games and pool upstairs
findings.note: Hornsea. ZIv games: Mario Kart Arcade GP DX, Super Bikes 2, Jurassic Park Arcade (2015) only. No music games listed on rhythm-focused site.

findings.name: Funstation Fountain Park
findings.evidence_quote: Mostly just ticket games Uses a card payment system, £5 gives you 20 credits
findings.note: Edinburgh Fountain Park. Listed cabs: Mario Kart GP DX, Super Bikes 2, Halo Fireteam Raven only. Funstation SMX/DDR known at other chain sites (Nottingham/Leeds), not evidenced here.

findings.name: Funstation Sheffield
findings.evidence_quote: Redemption Arcade and Hologate VR. Same spot as the old Namco Wonderpark (RIP). Don't expect frequent location tests of games from Japan here this time though
findings.note: Meadowhall. Large ZIv inventory updated 2026-03 (Mario Kart, Super Bikes 3, Halo Raven, Jurassic Park, many ticket games) with zero music games. Funstation Meadowhall FB replied SMX is at Nottingham site only.

findings.name: Funstation Xscape Castleford
findings.evidence_quote: Redemption arcade inside the Xscape building. This arcade uses a card system.
findings.note: Long ZIv game list (Mario Kart, Super Bikes 3, Halo Raven, Jurassic Park, Transformers, many redemption) with no DDR/PIU/SMX or other rhythm titles.

findings.name: Funworks (Haven - Hopton)
findings.evidence_quote: This info is as of 29th July 2011. There are two DS EM1 machines - one of them has a EM2 sign on it.
findings.note: Historical Dance Stage / EuroMIX machines and Guitar Hero in 2011 text. Page updated 2024-04 but current Games list only Animal Kaiser PLUS. Cannot confirm presence or removal of DDR-family cabs; treat as unknown.

findings.name: Funworks - Haven Lakeside
findings.evidence_quote: Arcade in Lakeside, Haven. Mostly redemption games
findings.note: Cark Lakeside Haven. ZIv list is pushers, Mario Kart GP DX, Asphalt Moto, Typhoon, etc. No music games.

findings.name: Gaiety Arcade
findings.evidence_quote: Aliens Armageddon; Battle Gear 4; Ghost Squad; Go Ball-istic; Let's Go Jungle; Monopoly Roll & Go; MotoGP Arcade; Need for Speed: Carbon; Pac-Man Smash; Pac-Man Ticket Mania; Sega Rally 3; Super Bikes (2P); Temple Run; Terminator Salvation
findings.note: Clacton Pier Avenue. ZIv inventory is racers/shooters/ticket only; no rhythm titles.

findings.name: Game On!
findings.evidence_quote: I forgot to add this place but they could be getting a dance game soon
findings.note: Carlisle multi-activity (bowling/mini-golf/small arcade). Only listed cab: Mario & Sonic Rio 2016 (OOS as of 2025-01). Comment speculated future dance game; no confirmation found. Venue site describes generic classic arcade (Pac-Man, air hockey).

findings.name: GamerX Wigan
findings.evidence_quote: No rhythm games. Claw Machines and some Arcade 1UP cabs
findings.note: Positive ZIv statement. Venue site is soft-play/go-karts/claw/VR/retro style family centre, not a bemani location.

findings.name: Gameshow
findings.evidence_quote: GRID (Twin Cab 2P); Need for Speed: Carbon; Razing Storm; Star Wars Battle Pod
findings.note: Clacton Pier Avenue next to Gaiety. Only racers/shooters on ZIv. No music games.

findings.name: Gashapon Bandai Official Shop Brighton
findings.evidence_quote: Store consisting of only gashapon machines. Arcade section removed.
findings.note: Capsule-toy / merchandise shop (plus One Piece TCG area). Not an arcade with playable rhythm cabs. Old comment asking about SMX pricing appears historical/misdirected.

findings.name: Gilly's Casino
findings.evidence_quote: Little sister to Gilly's amusements
findings.note: Scarborough foreshore. ZIv cabs: Big Buck Hunter Pro, Showdown, Super Bikes 2, Time Crisis 5 only.

findings.name: Glasgow Airport (Game Zone)
findings.evidence_quote: Not many games here in this arcade, considering it is a public area.
findings.note: Airport game zone. Listed: Rolling Stones pinball, NASCAR Racing, Hammer Head, Hockey Table. No rhythm.

findings.name: Go Bowling
findings.evidence_quote: Find all the arcade and pinball games available at GObowling in Dunstable on Insert Coin. Pump It Up PRIME Andamiro
findings.note: Dunstable GObowling. Insert Coin locator lists Pump It Up PRIME (Andamiro). Pipeline ZIv notes also said Pump It Up PRIME, but live ZIv page currently shows no games (updated 2025-03, empty). Treat as present with likely confidence pending on-site confirmation of version (PRIME vs later).

findings.name: Golden Bowls
findings.evidence_quote: At the Golden Coast Leasure Park, you don't need to be staying to visit but recommended. Bowling and table tennis downstairs
findings.note: Woolacombe Golden Coast. ZIv: Aliens Armageddon, GRID twin, Sonic Sports Basketball only.

findings.name: Golden Mile Amusements
findings.evidence_quote: Mission Impossible: Arcade
findings.note: Blackpool promenade. Only one cab on ZIv. Incomplete inventory; no positive no-rhythm statement and no music games found. Unknown.

findings.name: Golden Nugget Amusements
findings.evidence_quote: Daytona Championship USA; GRID (Deluxe Cab 1P); Super Bikes 2 (2P)
findings.note: Great Yarmouth Marine Parade. Racers only on ZIv; no music games found in search.

findings.name: Golden Sands
findings.evidence_quote: Mario Kart Arcade GP DX; MotoGP Arcade; Time Crisis 4; Cops & Robbers Pusher (4P); Crazy Typhoon; Deal or No Deal Mega Deluxe
findings.note: Cromer. Large ZIv inventory of pushers/ticket/racers/shooters; no rhythm titles.

findings.name: Goldengate Amusements
findings.evidence_quote: We cater to families looking for fun and prizes in our Family Entertainment Centre, as well as offering an Adult Gaming Centre, with the very latest machines
findings.note: Weston-super-Mare. ZIv: GRID, Super Bikes 2, Dinosaur Era, Mission Impossible, Barbercut, pushers, Space Invaders Frenzy. FEC/AGC style, no rhythm.

findings.name: Golf Fang Cardiff
findings.evidence_quote: [18+] Whilst the golf requires booking, you can visit just for the arcade. At the door (with ID check) they usually ask if you have a booking, just say your here just for arcade
findings.note: Adult mini-golf bar. Only Dead Heat (4P) listed on ZIv. No rhythm games found.

findings.name: Grand Casino
findings.evidence_quote: Guitar Hero Arcade (International) [listed under Music Game]. Comment: DDR cab was removed a month and a half ago. RIP
findings.note: Penzance Grand Casino Amusements still operating (venue site/Instagram open daily). Guitar Hero Arcade is the only music title still on ZIv (no dedicated slug; mapped to other). DDR removed per ~2018-19 comment. Inventory last updated 2019; re-verify on site.

findings.name: Grantham Bowl
findings.evidence_quote: Mario Kart Arcade GP; Sonic & Sega All-Stars Racing Arcade; Super Bikes (2P); The House of the Dead 3
findings.note: Bowling alley arcade: racers and HOTD3 only on ZIv. No rhythm.

findings.name: Gray's Amusements
findings.evidence_quote: NITRO SPEED; E-Claw 7000; Monster Drop X-TREME; Ocean Party; Tornado; Toy Stack; Wild West Shootout; All-Star Basketball Battle
findings.note: Sheringham High St branch. Ticket/claw/sports only on ZIv. Distinct from Mundesley Gray's.

findings.name: Gray's Amusements
findings.evidence_quote: Jetpack Joyride Arcade; Defender; Ms. Pac-Man; Fish Tales; The Addams Family; Sega Rally 2 Championship; Area 51; Star Wars Trilogy Arcade; The House of the Dead 3; Pac-Man Swirl; Space Invaders Part II; Alphine Surfer; Soul Surfer
findings.note: Mundesley Beach Road. Retro/pinball/rail list on ZIv and Instagram high-score style; no dedicated rhythm cabs listed.

findings.name: Gutterball Alley
findings.evidence_quote: This bowling alley has a large arcade with a lot of very nice condition games. As well as being in good condition, there is quite a few that you don't usually see around as much!
findings.note: North Shields (Lane7/Gutterball). Long ZIv list: Daytona USA, Luigi's Mansion, HOTD Scarlet Dawn, Transformers, Mario & Sonic Tokyo 2020, many ticket games. No DDR/PIU/SMX. Venue markets bowling/roller/karaoke/arcade redemption.

findings.name: HMV Newcastle Upon Tyne
findings.evidence_quote: Small collection of MAME cabinets and pinball tables.
findings.note: Eldon Square HMV. ZIv: MAME boards plus Stern pinballs (Jurassic Park, KISS, PotC, World Poker Tour). No dedicated commercial rhythm cabs. MAME may run home-style dance sims but that is not a listed public music-game cabinet.

findings.name: Haggerston castle arcade
findings.evidence_quote: Very small amount of games spread across 4 different arcades. The highlight is daytona championship USA, the rest is just ticket games. There's also a VR area which has 3 HTC vives at £7 for 20 minutes. Games include beat saber among others
findings.note: Haven/holiday park multi-arcade. Physical cabs: Daytona Championship USA, Space Invaders Frenzy, tickets. Beat Saber is VR only (not a map rhythm slug cab). No dedicated DDR/PIU/etc.

findings.name: Happy Dayz
findings.evidence_quote: Stacker
findings.note: Blackpool. Bare ZIv stub (only Stacker). Address too vague; no modern coverage found. Unknown.

findings.name: Happyland Amusements
findings.evidence_quote: Notable for having a JP DDRMAX2 cabinet in immaculate condition, although unfortunately it's supposedly running EuroMix2 (but was broken when I last saw it).
findings.note: Bournemouth West Undercliff. ZIv still describes JP DDRMAX2 (EuroMIX2 software), photo of cab on page. Not in active Games table (only Big Buck Hunter HD and Time Crisis 3 listed). Seasonal lock-up. Treat as possible/broken DDR presence; needs 2024+ visit confirmation.

findings.name: Harbour Park
findings.evidence_quote: Free to enter quite small amusement park with an arcade.
findings.note: Littlehampton. ZIv: 18 Wheeler, Final Furlong 2, Out Runners, Time Crisis II. Classic racers/shooter only.

findings.name: Harry's Amusements
findings.evidence_quote: Harrys Amusements are now closed for the foreseeable future.
findings.note: Weymouth Esplanade. ZIv last updated 2015 with broken EuroMIX2 (historical DDR). Operator closed site (UKVAC/blog ~2017-18). Facebook states closed for foreseeable future. Former building redevelopment discussed locally.

findings.name: Haven Cala Gran
findings.evidence_quote: A few redemption games here, for people who booked only.
findings.note: Fleetwood Haven. ZIv: Minecraft Dungeons Arcade, Super Bikes 2, Ultra Moto VR, pushers/Pac-Man Smash etc. No music games.

findings.name: Haven Doniford Bay
findings.evidence_quote: Loads of redemption, plus a few games.
findings.note: Doniford. Long redemption list plus Cruis'n Blast. No rhythm.

findings.name: Haven Skegness Holiday Park
findings.evidence_quote: This was originally the Richardsons Holiday Centre, but has now transferred to Haven. The arcade here is operated by Playnation by Inspired.
findings.note: Daytona Championship USA, Transformers Human Alliance, many pushers. No music games.

findings.name: Haven The Orchards
findings.evidence_quote: Not your usual holiday park, it's filled with redemption.
findings.note: Saint Osyth. Animal Kaiser, Cruis'n Blast, pushers/claws only.

findings.name: Haven Thornwick Bay
findings.evidence_quote: Mainly ticket games, mainly opearetd by Playnation.
findings.note: Flamborough. Crossy Road Arcade plus pushers only.

findings.name: Haven Wild Duck Holiday Park
findings.evidence_quote: Holiday park arcade ran by Namco with the Namco funscape branding. Uses cards which you top up with money similar to Sega Prize zone Caravan ownership or rental proof is required to enter the park.
findings.note: Belton. Animal Kaiser, Injustice Arcade, Cruis'n Blast, MotoGP, Jurassic Park 2015, Typhoon. No rhythm.
